findings.finding: Science-lane runner directly reimplemented Ollama serve/create/API operations, so OWRQ could qualify a different implementation than M6R2 executes.
findings.repair: Replace all direct Ollama operations with a frozen consumer interface to the exact OWRQ-qualified adapter blob.

findings.finding: Generic pre-outcome /api/chat exception was automatically classified as infrastructure failure without positive infra evidence.
findings.repair: Only use INVALID_INFRA_PREOUTCOME when adapter transport evidence explicitly records positive_infra_failure=true; otherwise fail closed as INVALID_PROVENANCE.

findings.finding: Qualified OWRQ artifact and adapter were not cryptographically bound to future S2/S3 authorization.
findings.repair: Require exact qualification SHA256, adapter Git blob, S1 lock binding and S2->S3 authorization binding.

findings.finding: Inline python -c JSON transport was fragile on Windows PowerShell quoting.
findings.repair: Use durable task/response JSON files and row-from-files CLI.

findings.finding: Cleanup/user-model restoration did not participate in final validity.
findings.repair: Consume qualified adapter cleanup evidence and invalidate as infrastructure if owned cleanup or initial/final model-set equality fails.

findings.finding: Evidence manifest was missing from final report.
findings.repair: Hash durable evidence/outcome-ledger files into final manifest.

findings.finding: Pure M6R2 contract was placed under pipeline package, causing pipeline/__init__.py to import unrelated PyYAML-dependent training modules during zero-science QA.
findings.repair: Move canonical pure contract to tools/m6r2_contract.py and load it directly without importing pipeline package.
